name: Munnar
tagline: Rolling tea hills of the Western Ghats
summary: Munnar is a cool hill station in Kerala, wrapped in endless emerald tea plantations. Walk among the tea bushes, learn how tea is made at the Tata Tea Museum, spot the rare Nilgiri tahr in Eravikulam National Park, and catch misty sunrise views from Kolukkumalai, one of the highest tea estates in the world.
seasonNote: September to March; monsoon (June to August) is lush but wet. Eravikulam closes in the tahr calving season (about February to March).
arrival: Kochi airport is about 4 hours by road.
gettingAround: Hire a car or jeep with driver; roads are winding.
cashTip: UPI is everywhere but foreign cards may not link; carry rupees for small places and taxis. Tip about 10 percent in restaurants.
foodTip: Kerala sadhya, appam with stew, and fresh cardamom tea.
baseArea: Near Munnar town or a tea-estate homestay
